name: Malmstrom AFB
description: Home of the 341st Missile Wing. Malmstrom AFB operates Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missiles across Montana and supports global strike operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: 10th Ave Gate (Main)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate with Visitor Control Center.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.notes: Visitor passes and base access. REAL ID required.

gates.name: 2nd Ave Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays

resources.name: Elkhorn Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting missile operations with full meal service and multiple food stations. Award-winning facility (Hennessy Trophy).
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Bfast 0600-0900, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1630-1830; Sat-Sun: Bfast 0730-0900, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1630-1800
resources.address: 303 75th St N, Bldg 1075, Malmstrom AFB, MT 59402

resources.name: Malmstrom Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food options.

resources.name: 1st Liberty Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.

resources.name: Fitness and Sport Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and sports amenities. 24/7 access available for registered patrons.
resources.hours: Daily 0500-2200 staffed; 24/7 access after registration at front desk
resources.address: 7547 Goddard Dr, Bldg 1010, Malmstrom AFB, MT 59402

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for missile wing personnel.

resources.name: Malmstrom Inns and Suites (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. Front desk open 0600-2200. 24/7 business center and small fitness room available. Pet-friendly TLF units available.
resources.address: 7028 4th Ave N, Bldg 1680, Malmstrom AFB, MT 59402

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.address: Bldg 1145, 7317 Goddard Dr, Malmstrom AFB, MT 59402

resources.name: 341st Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs supporting missile operations.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FAM Camp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Malmstrom Golf Course
resources.description: 9-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: 341st Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services supporting missile operations.

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 192)
primaryAction.address: 6200 Goddard Drive, Bldg 192, Malmstrom AFB, MT 59402

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Malmstrom Inns and Suites (406-731-3394) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 341 FSS, M&FRC, and official Malmstrom sites for in-processing and missile operations support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
